headline: Paratus Energy Services Awarded Petrobras Contract for Seagems Safira
summary: Paratus Energy Services announced that its joint venture, Seagems, has secured a contract following a tender process with the Brazilian state-controlled oil company Petrobras.
why: Contract wins with major national oil companies like Petrobras are significant revenue drivers for energy service providers, indicating operational success and future cash flow stability.

impacts.name: Paratus Energy Services
impacts.why: Securing a contract with a major client like Petrobras increases revenue visibility.
